_about: Structured transcriptions of the screenshot / PDF evidence. Produced once with Claude vision (see prompts/media_extraction.md) and cached so the full run is deterministic and needs no API key. Keys are sha256 prefixes of the file bytes; if a file changes the cache misses and media.py falls back to a live model call (when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set) or to text-only extraction.
